metadata.content: Matthias Jaissle: Newcastle boss apologises for Coventry loss as Jamie Carragher says they were 'beaten up' | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Matthias Jaissle: Newcastle boss apologises for Coventry loss as Jamie Carragher says they were 'beaten up' Newcastle suffer second consecutive 4-1 away loss after defeat at Coventry; Toon boss Matthias Jaissle: "We can only apologise to the fans who came here"; Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher: "In their last two away games, they've been beaten up twice - and that's got to stop very quickly" Monday 12 October 2026 23:46, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Matthias Jaissle apologises to the travelling Newcastle fans for the 4-1 defeat to Coventry Newcastle boss Matthias Jaissle has apologised to the travelling fans following their 4-1 loss at Coventry, as Jamie Carragher said they were "beaten up" once again on the road. The Magpies' previous away game a month ago also saw them defeated 4-1 on the Monday Night Football at Leeds. A second loss in three games comes after Jaissle had enjoyed an unbeaten five-game start across all competitions, but recent results have seen his side fall to 11th in the Premier League table. A wasteful Newcastle lost at Coventry despite having 19 shots, three big chances and more than double the number of touches in the opposition box than the home side. messages.text: Hamilton releases statement after 'painful lesson' in Singapore

metadata.summary: Lewis Hamilton has posted on social media to reiterate has apology to Ferrari after a "painful lesson" at the Singapore Grand Prix.
metadata.content: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver releases statement on Instagram after 'painful lesson' at Singapore GP | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver releases statement on Instagram after 'painful lesson' at Singapore GP Lewis Hamilton took to social media to apologise to Ferrari once again after his strategy call saw him drop out of the podium positions at the Singapore Grand Prix; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Monday 12 October 2026 15:34, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports F1's Karun Chadhok dissects Lewis Hamilton's Singapore GP race Lewis Hamilton has posted on social media to reiterate has apology to Ferrari after a "painful lesson" at the Singapore Grand Prix. Hamilton overrode Ferrari's strategy while on course for a podium finish by opting not to pit for fresh tyres during a Virtual Safety Car (VSC) period, leaving him vulnerable in the closing stages of the race. He was overtaken by Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc, who did pit when the VSC came out, and was subsequently passed by Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli, plus McLaren duo Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri as he dropped to sixth.
